inForce.statedAs: This consolidation is current to September 15, 2026. [Last amended July 1, 2026 by B.C. Reg. 97/2026]
inForce.basis: BC Laws presents this as the current consolidation of an unrepealed enactment; no repeal line appears in the document. Unit existence (2026-09-23): the authority's WMU service (openmaps.gov.bc.ca WHSE_WILDLIFE_MANAGEMENT.WAA_WILDLIFE_MGMT_UNITS_SVW, WFS GetFeature, sha256 60aace0cb181fc791addb05c23a6b85002022609c29b486bd248136be20f7ca7) returns 225 units, matching B.C. Reg. 64/96 s. 1 ('The Province is divided into 225 management units'). Region 8 has no units 8-16 to 8-20, so both ranges name the same 21 existing units. [OFFICIAL_SUMMARY tier, not this regulation:] The Synopsis states: 'MU's 8-1 to 8-15 and 8-21 to 8-26 is restricted to private land only. Hunters must obtain permission from landowners.' No source read disagrees about the units in effect; the printed range is recorded unchanged.
Composition omitted as for Sch. 4 s. 21.
LAND TENURE CONDITION — see the Sch. 4 s. 21 row.
